modules.title: Introduction to National Identity and Symbols
modules.html:
National symbols: the flag, coat of arms, national anthem and currency, and what they stand for. This section covers introduction to national identity and symbols.

Key points

  • National Symbols: — Flag, Anthem.
  • National identity promotes: — Patriotism.
  • National Integrity: — Honesty/Unity.
  • Which of these promotes national unity — Tolerance.
  • National Unity is threatened by: — Ethnicity/Tribalism.

Worked examples

Q: National Symbols:
A: Flag, Anthem — Past question (JAMB 2021). Correct answer: Flag, Anthem.

Q: National identity promotes:
A: Patriotism — Past question (JAMB 2022). Correct answer: Patriotism.

More key points

  • National Symbols: — Flag, Anthem.
  • National identity promotes: — Patriotism.
  • National Integrity: — Honesty/Unity.
  • Which of these promotes national unity — Tolerance.

quiz.q: The 'Ombudsman' in Nigeria is known as the _____.
quiz.solution: The Public Complaints Commission acts as an ombudsman, investigating complaints by citizens against administrative injustice by the government or private companies.

quiz.q: Civil society organizations (CSOs) help in _____.
quiz.solution: CSOs act as watchdogs, ensuring that the government remains transparent and respects the rights of citizens.

quiz.q: A person who sees an accident on the road and reports to the FRSC is performing his _____.
quiz.solution: Helping the state maintain order and safety is a civic responsibility of every citizen.

quiz.q: The ability to depend on one’s own effort and abilities to satisfy needs is known as _____.
quiz.solution: Self-reliance is a key value in Civic Education that encourages individuals to be independent and resourceful rather than waiting for external aid.

quiz.q: A permanent feature of the Civil Service is _____.
quiz.solution: Anonymity means civil servants are neither praised nor blamed publicly for policy outcomes; they work behind the scenes and remain out of the public eye.

quiz.q: The 'Ombudsman' in Nigeria is also known as the _____.
quiz.solution: The Public Complaints Commission acts as an ombudsman, investigating citizens' complaints against administrative injustice by the government or private companies.

quiz.q: Integrity is a value that helps to eliminate _____ in the public service.
quiz.solution: Honesty and integrity prevent public officers from engaging in bribery and embezzlement.

quiz.q: The white horses on the Nigerian Coat of Arms represent _____.
quiz.solution: The two horses standing on the sides of the shield represent the dignity and pride of Nigeria.
